mandate_request_identification.title: mandate_request_identification
mandate_request_identification.description: Specify Unique identification, as assigned by the clearing scheme, to identify the mandate.

mandate_identification.title: mandate_identification
mandate_identification.description: Specify Unique identification, as assigned by the clearing scheme, to identify the mandate.

status.title: status
status.description:
Specifies the status of the mandate registration requested.
PDNG=Pending
RJCT= Rejected
CRTD = Created
ACTV = Active
SUSD = Suspended
CNCD = Cancelled

name.title: name
name.description: Specify the name by which a party is known and which is used to identify that party. This parameter is mandatory for Australia if creditor `account_number` parameter value is present.

address_1.title: address_1
address_1.description: Specify the address of the party who involves in the payment flow. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

address_2.title: address_2
address_2.description: Specify the address of the party who involves in the payment flow. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

address_3.title: address_3
address_3.description: Specify the address of the party who involves in the payment flow. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

country_code.title: country_code
country_code.description: Specify the country code of the creditor address. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

postal_code.title: postal_code
postal_code.description: Specify the postal code of the creditor address. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

town_name.title: town_name
town_name.description: Specify the town name of the creditor address. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

mobile_number.title: mobile_number
mobile_number.description: Specify the mobile number of the creditor address. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

fax_number.title: fax_number
fax_number.description: Specify the fax number of the creditor address. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

email.title: email
email.description: Specify the Address for electronic mail (e-mail). This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

other_identification_category.title: other_identification_category
other_identification_category.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous identification of a party. either the value will be ORG or PVT. This is a mandatory parameter for Australia, if the creditor section is present.

other_identification_type.title: other_identification_type
other_identification_type.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous way to identify an organization/private identification. This is a mandatory parameter for Australia if the `other_identification_category` parameter is present.

other_identification.title: other_identification
other_identification.description: Specify the value of an organization/private identification. This is a mandatory parameter for Australia if the `other_identification_category` parameter is present.

iban.title: iban
iban.description: An identifier used internationally by financial institutions to uniquely identify the account of a customer at a financial institution, as described in the latest edition of the international standard ISO 13616: 2007 - Banking and related financial services - International Bank Account Number (IBAN). This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

bank_routing_code.title: bank_routing_code
bank_routing_code.description: Specify the Code allocated to a financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority as described in ISO 9362 Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC). This is a mandatory parameter for Australia if the 'account' parameter is present.

bank_branch_code.title: bank_branch_code
bank_branch_code.description: Specify the 6-digit BSB/9-digit account identification assigned by the Entity. This is a mandatory parameter for Australia if the `account` parameter is present.

scheme_identification.title: scheme_identification
scheme_identification.description: Specify the originator Creditor Scheme Identifier. This parameter is not applicable for Australia.

account.title: account
account.description: Specify the unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a debit entry will be posted as a result of the payment transaction.

account_type.title: account_type
account_type.description:
Specify the name of the identification scheme, in a coded form as published in an external list.
AIIN -Issuer Identification Number
BBAN- BBAN Identifier
CUID -CHIPS Universal Identifier
UPIC- UPIC Identifier
ALIA-Alias (proxy). This is a conditional parameter for Australia if creditor section is present and only BBAN is applicable for Australia and no proxy is allowed.
This is a mandatory parameter for Australia if creditor section is present.
For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

proxy_id.title: proxy_id
proxy_id.description: Specify the identification used to indicate the account identification under another specified name. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

proxy_type.description:

UBIL-UtilitiesSubscriptionIdentification

BIID-BillerSubscriberIdentification. This parameter is not applicable for Australia.

name.title: name
name.description: Specify the name by which a party is known and which is used to identify that party. This parameter is mandatory for Australia.

account.title: account
account.description: Specify the unique identification of an account, as assigned by the account servicer, using an identification scheme. This parameter is mandatory for Australia.

other_identification_category.title: other_identification_category
other_identification_category.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous identification of a party. the value will be organization/Private. This parameter is mandatory for Australia.

other_identification_type.title: other_identification_type
other_identification_type.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous type to identify an organization/private identification. This parameter is mandatory for Australia.

other_identification.title: other_identification
other_identification.description: Specify the value of an organization/private identification type. This parameter is mandatory for Australia.

bank_routing_code.title: bank_routing_code
bank_routing_code.description: Specify the unique identification of an organization, as assigned by an institution, using an identification scheme. This parameter is mandatory for Australia.

code.title: code
code.description: Unique ID for the error code.

becs_user_identification.title: becs_user_identification
becs_user_identification.description: BECS user ID related to migrated DDR mandate. This parameter is conditional to Australia if mandate_scheme is MGCR.

country.title: country
country.description:
Specify the country code where the mandate request has been originated.
Australia = AU
Hongkong = HK
Argentina = AR
SEPA = UK

mandate_description.title: mandate_description
mandate_description.description:
Specify the description of the reason for mandate setup as narrative text.
This parameter is specific to Australia. Both mandate_description and mandate_additional_ information parameters are expected to be sent by client for Australia. This parameter is eligible to be amended unilaterally.

sequence_type.title: sequence_type
sequence_type.description:
Specify the underlying transaction sequence as either recurring or one-off.
Only RCUR applicable for AU.

payment_frequency.title: payment_frequency
payment_frequency.description:
Specify the regularity of an event.
ADHO = Ad hoc (Event takes place on request or as necessary)
DAIL = Daily (Event takes place every day)
FRTN = Fortnightly (Event takes place every two weeks)
INDA = Intraday (Event takes place several times a day)
MIAN = Semiannual (Event takes place every six months or two times a year)
MNTH = Monthly (Event takes place every month)
QURT = Quarterly (Event takes place every three months)
WEEK = Weekly (Event takes place once a week)
YEAR = Annual (Event takes place every year or once a year)

count_per_period.title: count_per_period
count_per_period.description: Specify the frequency in terms of the number of instructions to be created and processed during the specified period. count_per_period (or) point_in_time is a mandatory parameter for Australia.

point_in_time.title: point_in_time
point_in_time.description: Specify the frequency in terms of an exact point in time or moment within the specified period.

tracking_indicator.title: tracking_indicator
tracking_indicator.description: Specify the indicating value either True or False, whether the direct debit instructions should be automatically re-submitted periodically when bilaterally agreed.

mandate_additional_information.title: mandate_additional_information
mandate_additional_information.description: Specify the additional information in free text form to complement the mandate information. This parameter is specific to Australia. Both mandate_description and mandate_additional_information parameters are expected to be sent by client for Australia. This parameter is eligible for amendment unilaterally.

payment_execution_not_before_time.title: payment_execution_not_before_time
payment_execution_not_before_time.description: Indicates that each execution of the mandate payment should not occur before a given time (hh:mm:ss.sssZ) of that execution day. This parameter is specific to Australia.

transfer_arrangement.title: transfer_arrangement
transfer_arrangement.description: Indication of future transfer date, conditions of sale and requirement to hold funds. This parameter is specific to Australia.

resolution_requested_by.title: resolution_requested_by
resolution_requested_by.description: Time used to indicate by when resolution of a bilateral action is requested from the other party to the mandate. This parameter is specific to Australia.

service_id.title: service_id
service_id.description: specify a pre-agreed service or level of service between the parties. This parameter is mandatory for Australia.

instruction_priority.title: instruction_priority
instruction_priority.description: Specifies the priority level of an event. This parameter is specific to Australia and it is mandatory for Australia. Instruction priority” parameter value will be 'UNAT' or 'NORM'.

mandate_start_date.title: mandate_start_date
mandate_start_date.description: Start date of the validity of the mandate. Calender year expressed in the YYYY-MM-DD format.

mandate_expiry_date.title: mandate_expiry_date
mandate_expiry_date.description: Specify the End date of the validity of the mandate. Calender year expressed in the YYYY-MM-DD format.

mandate_first_collection_date.title: mandate_first_collection_date
mandate_first_collection_date.description: Specify the Date of the first collection of a direct debit as per the mandate. Calender year expressed in the YYYY-MM-DD format.

mandate_final_collection_date.title: mandate_final_collection_date
mandate_final_collection_date.description: Specify the Date of the final collection of a direct debit as per the mandate. Calender year expressed in the YYYY-MM-DD format.

mandate_type.title: mandate_type
mandate_type.description:
Specify the type of mandate.
DDMC-Direct Debit Confirmed Electronic Mandate
DDMP-Direct Debit Paper Mandate With Paper Authorization
DDMU-Direct Debit Unconfirmed Electronic Mandate
DDTP-Mandate type relates to Direct Debit payment instrument
SOTP-Mandate type relates to Standing Order payment instrument
'OTHR' for Third party mandates

mandate_scheme.title: mandate_scheme
mandate_scheme.description: Specify the arrangement (unilateral or bilateral) and party that established the mandate. This parameter is mandatory for Australia.

mandate_purpose.title: mandate_purpose
mandate_purpose.description: Specify the high-level purpose of the mandate. This parameter is mandatory for Australia.

payment_amount_type.title: payment_amount_type
payment_amount_type.description:
Specify the mandate payment arrangement.
FIXE -Fixed Direct debit amount is fixed.
USGB -Usage Based Direct debit amount is based on usage.
VARI -Variable Direct debit amount is variable
BALN- Balloon Payment. This parameter is mandatory for Australia

debtor_reference_number.title: debtor_reference_number
debtor_reference_number.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous identification as assigned by the creditor to the referred document shared with the debtor for its own reference.

debtor_code.title: debtor_code
debtor_code.description: Specify the Proprietary identification of the type of the remittance document.

creditor_reference_number.title: creditor_reference_number
creditor_reference_number.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous identification as assigned by the debtor to the referred document shared with the creditor for its own reference.

payment_reference_number.title: payment_reference_number
payment_reference_number.description: Specify the proprietary identification of the type of the remittance document. This parameter is not applicable for Australia.

currency.title: currency
currency.description: Specify the collection account currency. This parameter is mandatory for Australia

amount.title: amount
amount.description: Specify the Fixed amount to be collected from the debtors account. For Australia if payment_amount_type parameter is equal to FIXE then this parameter is mandatory.

maximum_amount.title: maximum_amount
maximum_amount.description: Specify the Maximum amount that is collected from the debtors account. For Australia if payment_amount_type parameter is not equal to FIXE then this parameter is mandatory.

first_collection_amount.title: first_collection_amount
first_collection_amount.description: Specify the first collection amount to be collected from the debtors account.

final_collection_amount.title: final_collection_amount
final_collection_amount.description: Specify the final collection amount to be collected from the debtors account.

cummulative_amount.title: cummulative_amount
cummulative_amount.description: Specify the cumulative fixed amount to be collected from the debtors account. This parameter is not applicable for Australia.

ultimate_debtor_name.title: ultimate_debtor_name
ultimate_debtor_name.description: Specify the name by which the ultimate debtor is known and which is used to identify that party. This parameter is mandatory for Australia.

ultimate_creditor_name.title: ultimate_creditor_name
ultimate_creditor_name.description: Specify the name by which the ultimate creditor is known and which is used to identify that party. This parameter is mandatory for Australia. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.
